title: Batch-Conditioned Semantic Anchors for Robust Transductive Adaptation of Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transductive adaptation improves vision-language models at test time by refining predictions on an unlabeled batch, but current methods face a key trade-off. Aggressive approaches exploit batch structure but can drift when batches are sparse, have prior shift, or cover little of the label space. Conservative methods better preserve CLIP text semantics, but fixed semantic references can under-adapt even when the batch provides strong corrective evidence. We propose JPTA (Joint Prior and Transport Adaptation), a prior-aware framework that casts transductive VLM adaptation as batch-conditioned semantic reference estimation. Instead of treating CLIP text prototypes as fixed priors or freely replaceable, JPTA views them as semantic references that shift toward image-side batch structure only under calibrated evidence. translated_title: 面向视觉-语言模型鲁棒直推式自适应的批条件语义锚点
translated_abstract: 直推式自适应通过在未标注批次上细化预测来在测试时改进视觉-语言模型，但现有方法面临一个关键权衡。激进的方法利用批次结构，但当批次稀疏、存在先验偏移或仅覆盖标签空间的一小部分时可能发生漂移。保守的方法能更好地保留CLIP的文本语义，但固定的语义参考即使当批次提供了强矫正证据时也可能适应不足。我们提出JPTA（联合先验与传输自适应），这是一个先验感知框架，它将直推式VLM自适应转化为批条件语义参考估计问题。JPTA既不将CLIP文本原型视为固定先验，也不将其视为可自由替换的对象，而是将其视为仅在经过校准的证据下才向图像侧批次结构偏移的语义参考。它通过估计批次先验和软图像侧原型来形成传输后的语义参考，其影响程度由b……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出JPTA框架，将直推式视觉-语言模型自适应建模为批条件语义参考估计，通过联合估计批次先验与软图像侧原型，仅在经校准的证据下让CLIP文本语义参考向批次结构偏移，从而在利用批次信息与保留文本语义之间实现鲁棒平衡。
en_tdlr: JPTA casts transductive VLM adaptation as batch-conditioned semantic reference estimation, jointly estimating batch priors and soft image-side prototypes so that CLIP text semantic references shift toward batch structure only under calibrated evidence, achieving a robust balance between exploiting batch information and preserving text semantics.
